deliverables.title: Frozen human/group electorates and first-admitted final ballots
Restart/replay, two-node equality, and observer catch-up

blocking_protocol_gaps.description: Current governance supports attributable vote revocation, conflicting with the scoped first-admitted final ballot contract.
blocking_protocol_gaps.closure_condition: First valid admitted ballot is immutable; duplicate, replacement, and revoke attempts fail deterministically.

blocking_protocol_gaps.description: Some governance authorization surfaces use configured validators instead of scope-correct Tier-2 or group electorates.
blocking_protocol_gaps.closure_condition: Electorate membership and denominator freeze at the correct block height; validators have no political weight unless independently eligible as humans.

scope_exclusions.reason: Group treasury spending belongs to R-M4 and remains economics-gated.
Executable governance actions, software application, migrations, rollback, and treasury/economic effects are not required for the bounded M3 no-action civic finalization proof.
Emergency-governance severity classes and accelerated authority remain a later implementation scope.
Production account exclusion and live economic slashing are outside the M3 controlled-testnet dispute proof.
Real remote signed observer onboarding is a separate reviewer track.
Economics, wallet, rewards, and treasury accounting are separate.
Public validator and multi-validator BFT readiness are separate.
